title: Discount
description: Abstract base of every price reduction acme can express. Extended through allOf; never instantiated alone.

label.description: What the customer is shown on the basket line, e.g. "Spring sale".

applies-to.description: Scope of the reduction. Decides which total the arithmetic is applied to.

currency.description: Currency this discount may be applied in. One per discount, per ADR 0001.

stackable.description: Whether this discount may combine with others on the same cart.

oneOf.title: Percentage
oneOf.description: A proportional reduction, expressed in basis points to keep the arithmetic exact.

basis-points.description: Hundredths of a percent. 1500 is 15%; 10000 makes the scoped total free.

cap.description: Optional ceiling on the reduction, so a percentage cannot uncap the spend.

oneOf.title: Fixed amount
oneOf.description: A flat reduction of a stated amount, never below zero on the resulting total.

amount.description: Amount taken off the scoped total. Clamped at the total, never negative.

minimum-spend.description: Threshold the scoped total must reach before this discount is eligible.

oneOf.title: Free shipping
oneOf.description: Removes the shipping charge. Carries no arithmetic of its own beyond an optional ceiling.

max-refund.description: Ceiling on the shipping charge absorbed, for expedited options acme will not fund.
